property_summary: After processing any valid fallback call, the contract's balance is zero if and only if the block number of the call was divisible by 15; the mutant incorrectly transfers on block numbers divisible by 14, causing a zero balance when it should be non-zero (or vice-versa).
change_summary: Change the condition in the if statement to block.number % 14 == 0, altering when the balance transfer occurs.
